usage: laplace-search [-h] [--top-k TOP_K] [--db-path DB_PATH] [--table TABLE]
                      [--full] [--json] [--recall] [--today YYYY-MM-DD]
                      query

Probe the stream archive index from the command line.

positional arguments:
  query               Search query (the question you'd ask the bot)

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --top-k TOP_K       Number of results to return (default: 5)
  --db-path DB_PATH   LanceDB dir (default: data/lancedb)
  --table TABLE       Table name (default: stream_chunks)
  --full              Print full chunk text instead of a 200-char preview
  --json              Emit raw JSON (drops vector field for readability)
  --recall            Use broadcast recaps or details within a resolved period
                      (JSON emits an envelope)
  --today YYYY-MM-DD  Persona-local reference date for --recall (default:
                      today in PERSONA_TIMEZONE)

usage: laplace-eval-retrieval [-h] [--queries QUERIES] [--db-path DB_PATH]
                              [--table {persona_facts,stream_chunks}]
                              [--modes {vector_only,hybrid,hybrid_rerank} [{vector_only,hybrid,hybrid_rerank} ...]]
                              [--facts-candidates FACTS_CANDIDATES]
                              [--stream-candidates STREAM_CANDIDATES]
                              [--date-filter | --no-date-filter] [--verbose]
                              [--save SAVE] [--compare COMPARE]
                              [--rerank-models MODEL [MODEL ...]]

Score retrieval quality for both LanceDB tables.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --queries QUERIES     TOML file of [[query]] entries (default:
                        data/eval/queries.toml)
  --db-path DB_PATH     LanceDB directory (default: data/lancedb)
  --table {persona_facts,stream_chunks}
                        Restrict eval to one table. Default: both.
  --modes {vector_only,hybrid,hybrid_rerank} [{vector_only,hybrid,hybrid_rerank} ...]
                        Subset of retrieval modes to test. Default: all of
                        ('vector_only', 'hybrid', 'hybrid_rerank').
  --facts-candidates FACTS_CANDIDATES
                        Hybrid-search candidate pool size for persona_facts
                        (default: 30).
  --stream-candidates STREAM_CANDIDATES
                        Hybrid-search candidate pool size for stream_chunks
                        (default: 15).
  --date-filter, --no-date-filter
                        Apply date pre-filter when query mentions a date
                        (default: on).
  --verbose             Print per-query rank breakdown after the summary
                        table.
  --save SAVE           Save metrics to a JSON file for later --compare.
  --compare COMPARE     Compare current run against a previously saved metrics
                        JSON.
  --rerank-models MODEL [MODEL ...]
                        Benchmark mode: run the query set through each named
                        Cohere reranker model and report quality + latency
                        side-by-side. Requires COHERE_API_KEY. Example:
                        --rerank-models rerank-multilingual-v3.0
                        rerank-v4.0-fast rerank-v4.0-pro. When set, the
                        regular --modes path is skipped — output is the model-
                        comparison table instead.

Generate an image from a text prompt plus optional reference images. The bot's
selfie tool and this script share one path — ``image_generation`` owns the
OpenRouter call and the built-in prompt, so what you probe here is what a
viewer gets. Usage: uv run laplace-generate-image "put her in a red scarf,
keep the pose" -i ref.png -o out.png uv run laplace-generate-image -i ref.png
# falls back to the built-in prompt uv run laplace-generate-image --friend
七海Nana7mi # the group-selfie variant

positional arguments:
  prompt                What to generate, or how to edit the references
                        (default: the built-in prompt)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -i, --image PATH_OR_URL
                        Reference image, local path or URL; repeat for up to
                        16. Defaults to the outfit the bot would use at this
                        hour; naming one here bypasses that choice.
  -o, --out OUT         Where to write it; the suffix follows the response
                        (default: data/generated/image.png)
  -n N                  How many to generate, 1-10 (default: 1)
  --model MODEL         OpenRouter model slug (default: openai/gpt-
                        image-2.5-flare)
  --aspect-ratio {auto,1:1,3:2,2:3,4:3,3:4,16:9,9:16,21:9}
  --quality {auto,low,medium,high,xhigh,max}
  --friend NAME         Put a friend from selfie-references/friends in the
                        shot; repeat for more
